reviews.comment: I'm taking her at west chester univ for public speaking. DO NOT TAKE HER. Her rubrics and criteria are not clear whatsoever and she constantly changes it. She is a harsh grader. She barely helps when asking for feedback. She gives highly inappropriate assignments to do as attendance. This is not an easy class at all, basically is a research class

Dr. Miller is one of the best professors I have taken at A&M! She extremely understanding and clear on what you need to do well on the class. The weekly assignments were about a page long and oftentimes you could provide personal examples making it very easy to complete. Quizzes were not hard if you read the material beforehand. Highly recommend!

Prof. Miller is a sweetheart and this class is interesting if you're interested in internet culture! She's not the best public speaker but she knows what she's talking about. Assignments/exams are simple and the material was interesting IMO. Liked her a lot this semester!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly, if you want an easy class that you don't have to do much work, this is for you. However, it is really sad how few people attend her classes. Her lectures are kind of pointless and exams are open book.

Shes a good professor but her classes are extremely boring. Attendance isnt required and the tests come straight from the notes. Make sure to do all of the little assignments because those can make or break your grade.

This class is interesting but the lectures are not. But attendance isn't required and you can still get a good grade because her lectures don't really apply to the material tested. One assignment a week which is super easy and as long as you try you will get a 100. Exams are online and open note and she gives a study guide.

The most boring lecturer ever. A lot of what they talked about in this class was personal interest, they discussed anime and geeks for 2 weeks and then when it came to sports fandom they somehow completed two whole lectures in one class. The class was so easy but you wont learn anything. There's a weekly assignment and test reviews are given.

Lectures can get a bit boring but class is easy overall! CTA assignments are given every week and she's a nice grader as long as u meet all the rubric expectations. Exams are all based of lectures and she gives a reading guide for test which makes if even better. She's very nice and it was an enjoyable class overall!

When I say I didn't go to class a single time, I mean it. 3 tests and they're all online. Each week besides test weeks, you have a writing assignment but they're so easy. 100% would recommend her for this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Class was easy, one online weekly assignment, and 3 exams. Test are taken at home online. She is very nice, responds fast, probably my favorite class I've taken.
Shes amazing! Soft spoken but as long as you keep up and do the work then its a smooth breeze. Open note test and weekly writing assignments due on Sunday. Love her and took her again for COMM 420

I am indifferent to Dr. Miller and this class. The class itself was meh, nothing to ride home about. There was nothing particularly awful, but nothing was amazing either. The tests weren't hard. You could do worse, but you could do better in the communication department. We learned a lot about Anime fandom. I will likely remember that the most.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There are weekly lectures that go at most an hour, but you can speed them up on YouTube. From those lectures every week, you either take an open-note quiz or you write a 2 paragraph response. That's it. 2 group projects had the lowest grades, but with more effort and planning, it would've been higher. Easy A. Dr. Miller understands the content!

Overall, a very nice, soft-spoken lady. Her class solely contains lectures, straight from her PowerPoints. Her exams are straight from her study guides (if you do them). Your entire grade is made up of 10 CTAs (easy and quick), and 3 exams (straight from her study guide). She offers an easy piece of extra credit, worth 4 bonus exam points, at end.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Do not recommend this professor. Does not care about students. Shows no empathy towards students who try their absolute hardest. Too much work for no reward in the end. This class is the definition of "How to pass a class without learning anything."

Tough essay grader but easy exams. If you go to class and take notes on lectures you don't need to do daily readings -- they frame what you actually need to know for the test in lecture. Super sweet prof and uses relevant examples to our generation. Super knowledgeable about their field. Tests are given online and really minimal courseload
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: I didn't watch a single lecture that was posted and still got a C. I easily could've gotten a higher grade with a little bit of effort. The papers are easy enough to bs and the prof doesn't grade them hard at all. For the quizzes all you need are the power points as the questions are pretty much word for word.

Take Lucy Miller. Her lectures can be boring but literally make up the tests, so if you listen and take notes, you will make an A. There are short writing assignments after every class that are so easy (if you attended) and make up most of your grade. Super easy class!

I took American Oratory asynchronously online. You just have to do one thing a week, either a "CTA" in which you just write a paragraph analyzing a speech (these aren't graded that harshly) or you take a quiz which is open note. There are two group projects, for some reason she grades these really hard but they shouldn't be grade killers.

Super easy but boring class. 100% over zoom and didn't record lectures so you need to be there during class time to take notes. after every class there's a small assignment about what she talked about during that class but it's easy because you only needed to write like two sentences. only 3 tests and didn't proctor them. boring lectures but easy A
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Super easy class. There's only 3 tests and then daily participation grades which are super easy. Lectures can be boring but what lectures aren't? Her tests are just like the review so pay attention when she goes over the review in class. The only complaint I have is that she speaks softly so it can be hard to hear her, so sit in the front!

Dr. Miller doesn't take attendance but she does do daily grades at the end of every class so make sure you go. She gives out test reviews that are similar to the exam. I took her for 2 classes this semester and both are laid out the same. Great proff! Emails back quickly if you have any questions. Easy grader.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class is so interesting and Dr. Miller cares about her students. There are 2 papers and 2 tests but she gives great feedback and wants you to succeed. There are in class assignments everyday but as long as you don't miss too many it shouldn't affect your grade that much. Def recommend!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Miller is awesome! She is so passionate about what she does and is willing to help anyone, you just have to put in the effort. I would definitely take her again!

The quizzes were over a lot of different material but if you take notes (word for word) from the lectures and look through your document you'll find all the answers, combined with the power points. The group projects were graded MUCH harder than expected and the work your group members do can cost you majorly. Wouldn't recommend for easy credit.

Miller is a great prof and is extremely understanding and helpful if you go talk to her in person! The class is incredibly difficult for an online class and she has a tough grader, but if you put in the work you'll be fine. The quizzes aren't that bad but make sure to watch the lecture videos first if you want to do well on them!

She is a very tough grader, I would not take her again. Although she was a nice person and her lectures were okay, I wouldn't recommend her because it is very hard to get an A in the class. You have to have natural public speaking abilities and if you're nervous about public speaking you will probably not do well in this class
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Miller dedicates the day before an exam to go over the review and answers questions for the whole class time. voice is soft so sit closer to the front. there are critical thinking assignments every class and are worth a good portion of your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Miller is a great choice for a professor - no homework, minimal to no reading, and gives reviews for exams. She even does a review day where she answers questions on the review. She says she doesn't take attendance, but there are in-class small assignments every day. She is quite soft-spoken so sit in the front. Take her!

Dr. Miller is awesome! She is really sweet and knowledgable, and even though the public speaking aspect of this class was inevitably dreadful, I'm still glad I took it from her. Little to no homework outside of preparing your speeches! Take her if you can!

Despite being a public speaking professor, Dr. Miller is very soft spoken and portrays a nervous demeanor. Her rubrics are very clear however, there have been multiple times when my returned work has said "go into more detail" in my speech, with no clear answer on how to improve. You have to be a confident public speaker, it's less about material.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: she has you answer a question on paper every class as attendence, but its always completion and missing a few won't hurt you. tests are exactly like the review

This is the best professor I have ever had. Her demeanor takes some getting used to, but this is the most I have ever learned and I really enjoyed her as a person. The class is set up to be an easy A as long as you study the review!

Dr. Miller is very approachable and nice. Is very willing to help as long as you put in effort. Don't expect to make an A unless you are not nervous about public speaking at all. Does offer extra credit at the end of the course which was nice but didn't help much. Speeches aren't that bad, grading mainly comes from presentation, not material.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Miller is a great professor. She is really knowledgeable about the content that she teaches. Very approachable. Dr. Miller does speak fairly quietly, so sit near the front of the class.
Take detailed notes, show up, and study the review for a few hours and you will have all the information needed to earn an A in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Lucy is very knowledgeable on the material she covers and is willing to help you out in anything. Class consists of daily Critical Thinking Assignments, (some in small groups) therefore attendance matters. There's a total of 3 exams, study study study the review and you should be good.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Miller is very nice and approachable. She does grade the speeches a bit hard for an intro to public speaking class. A B is pretty easy to achieve but an A will take lots of time and natural public speaking ability.

Great class! Took it online this summer, discussion questions for each chapter & three exams! Watch the lecture videos  before the test while following along in the textbook & took notes! Learned a lot!!!!
